manages the complete staking lifecycle: 1. Users deposit STAKE. 2. The vault tracks each user's staking position. 3. REWARD tokens are emitted over time according to `rewardRate`. 4. Users accumulate rewards proportional to their share of the pool. 5. Users can claim rewards. 6. Users can withdraw their STAKE. 7. Users can exit by claiming rewards and withdrawing their entire stake. The vault does not mint REWARD tokens. Rewards must first be funded through `fundRewards()`. Reward accounting uses the standard cumulative `rewardPerToken` model. This allows rewards to be calculated efficiently without iterating over every staker. Reward funding is finite:      Treasury          \u2502          \u2502 REWARD          \u25bc    StakingVault          \u2502          \u2502 emission          \u25bc       Stakers When the funded reward balance is exhausted, reward emission stops until additional REWARD tokens are funded.","errors":{"EnforcedPause()":[{"details":"The operation failed because the contract is paused."}],"ExpectedPause()":[{"details":"The operation failed because the contract is not paused."}],"OwnableInvalidOwner(address)":[{"details":"The owner is not a valid owner account. claimRewards().details: The user's reward accounting is updated before the reward is transferred.

constructor.details: The deployer becomes the initial owner and can configure the reward emission rate, fund rewards, and pause or unpause the vault.

exit().details: This is a convenience function that combines reward claiming and full withdrawal into a single transaction. The function intentionally does not revert when the user has no rewards. This allows a user to exit even if their pending reward amount is zero.

fundRewards(uint256).details: The caller must approve the vault to spend the specified amount of REWARD. Funding rewards increases the finite reward pool available for future emissions.

params.amount: Amount of REWARD tokens to fund.

returns.amount: Current STAKE deposited by the user.
returns.rewardPerTokenPaid: Reward-per-token value last accounted for         the user.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pause().details: Reward funding and administrative configuration remain available while the protocol is paused.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

rewardPerToken().details: The returned value includes rewards that have accrued since the last global accounting update.

returns._0: The amount of REWARD emitted per second.

setRewardRate(uint256).details: Global reward accounting is updated before the new rate is applied. This prevents the new rate from being applied retroactively to the period before this function was called.

params.newRate: New amount of REWARD emitted per second.

stake(uint256).details: The caller must first approve the vault to spend the specified amount of STAKE. The user's pending rewards are updated before their staking position changes.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

withdraw(uint256).details: The user's pending rewards are updated before their staking position changes.

claimRewards().notice: Claims all currently accrued REWARD tokens.

earned(address).notice: Returns the amount of REWARD currently earned by a user.

exit().notice: Claims all accrued rewards and withdraws the user's entire         staking position.

fundRewards(uint256).notice: Funds the vault with REWARD tokens.

getUserInfo(address).notice: Returns a user's complete staking information.

pause().notice: Pauses staking, withdrawals, and reward claims.

rewardPerToken().notice: Returns the current cumulative reward per STAKE token.

rewardRate().notice: Returns the current REWARD emission rate.

rewardRemaining().notice: Returns the amount of funded REWARD that has not yet been         emitted.

stakeToken().notice: Token users deposit into the vault.

totalStaked().notice: Returns the total amount of STAKE deposited in the vault.
